env_allowlist.PATH: inherited only for pinned executable discovery
env_allowlist.HOME: inherited only for the pinned Elan toolchain location

recipe.network_enforcement: The checker performs local structural reconciliation, then check_validation.sh runs every Lean subprocess through Bubblewrap --unshare-net with a read-only host root and a fresh writable temporary output directory.
recipe.dependency_policy: Reuse the automation-provided canonical pinned mathlib source and compiled artifacts read-only. Do not update, build, clone, fetch, or mutate .lake. This is warm-cache negative release-decision evidence, not cold hermetic release evidence.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line PASS/BLOCKED negative release summary

recipe.scope_boundary: Self-tests the fail-closed release reconciliation and replays the existing network-isolated trust-zero kernel probe. It does not supply master acceptance, authoritative graph reconciliation, H0/R0 review, complete provenance/TCB/SBOM, immutable clean empty-cache reproduction, a deterministic bundle, or independent verification.
